hypotheses.B0_exact_bilinear_decomposition: The three product-rule terms recompose the finite final-position MLP write below 2e-5 relative error.
hypotheses.B1_both_cross_terms_are_material: Each cross term receives at least 0.15 absolute local-write projection in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.B2_quadratic_edit_term_is_minor: The edit-squared term receives at most 0.25 absolute local-write projection in every cell.
hypotheses.B3_state_write_ranking_is_useful: Top-256 channels by state-conditioned write magnitude reach at least 0.40 downstream fidelity in every cell.
hypotheses.B4_local_contribution_ranking_recovers_t: Top-256 channels by exact local contribution reach at least 0.70 downstream fidelity in every cell.
hypotheses.B5_state_contraction_beats_static_norm: State-conditioned write magnitude beats static decoder norm by at least 0.20 in every cell.
hypotheses.B6_conditional_program_transfers_ood: TinyStories state-write fidelity is at least 80% of FineWeb at each layer.
